exposure: UNICEF scoring system for breastfeeding assessment
LATCH scoring system for breastfeeding assessment
outcome: correlation between UNICEF and LATCH scores
cohort: Stable mother-neonate dyads where neonates were >=34 weeks gestational age and breastfeeding was initiated within 6 hours of life were included in the study.
finding: The study found a positive correlation between LATCH and UNICEF scores, showing good percent agreement across assessment days and high test-retest reliability for the tools on days 1 and 2.
